description: T-107: MAP and a gang house FILE DESCRIPTION room, both read from the text files import unpacks into the assets directory. The room is 15:857, which has no placed items: a placed item such as 15:850's white banner is put back by a cold start and swept by each midnight cleanup of a closed house, so it would depend on each server's uptime. Needs the developer code on both sides: on the original CODEC_OF_TWINKS=78 in wccmmud.ini (STAGE_CODEC_OF_TWINKS or docker -e CODEC_OF_TWINKS) and the BBS key WCCSYSOP on the sysop account (mbbsemu_key.py; TWEAK, SUMMON, EXPRESS_TRAIN, MONSTER), on silvermere the DEBUG grant (`silvermere account grant sysop DEBUG`); and the BBS sysop account sysop/sysop with its character Sysadm on both (docs/testing.md, M4).
